ud6ve:21: Methodological Flaws in CAISI V4 IRT Evaluation
w2kgph:404: CAISI (Center for AI Standards and Innovation) uses Item Response Theory to compute Elo scores across 9 different benchmarks, assessing the gap between open models like DeepSeek V4 and U.S. frontier models. On the surface, this IRT approach allows comparisons across different benchmark sets, but the actual results show DeepSeek V4 scoring abnormally low on CTF-Archive-Diamond, PortBench (CAISI's private benchmark), and ARC-AGI-2 — where CTF-Archive-Diamond only ran partial benchmarks and was extrapolated via IRT, PortBench is a closed-source evaluation, and ARC-AGI-2's scoring method differs from the public leaderboard. These benchmark-specific outliers have an outsized impact on the overall Elo, amplifying the perceived magnitude of the capability gap.
